name: job-hunt-os
description: Job search workspace with a deterministic read-only morning planner and local dashboard.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run privacy:check
scripts.morning:plan: npm run compile --silent && node dist/src/cli.js plan
scripts.doctor: npm run compile --silent && node dist/src/cli.js doctor
